description: Ex-USAAF WWII Dakota, later one of two Birla group Dakotas, flown until the mid-1990s and donated to the Dharmasthala museum; red/white livery, under a purpose-built shelter (warbirds.in).
HT-2 displayed alongside the Dakota; aviationmuseum.eu gives painted number 10; true serial unknown.
Blue-painted HT-2 marked 10, display board says it flew from AFS Bidar; BR identifies it as IX-710. Source WoI, BR.
